title: Safety of Cultured Allogeneic Adult Umbilical Cord or Placental Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells for Skin Ulcer
official: Safety of Cultured Allogeneic Adult Umbilical Cord or Placental Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells for the Treatment of Skin Ulcer
summary: This trial will study the safety and efficacy of intravenous infusion and intralesional injection of cultured allogeneic adult umbilical cord or placental derived mesenchymal stem cells for the treatment of Skin Ulcer

interventions.name: cultured allogeneic adult umbilical cord or placental derived mesenchymal stem cells

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of Skin Ulcer
* Understanding and willingness to sign a written informed consent document

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active infection
* Active cancer
* Chronic multisystem organ failure
* Pregnancy
* Clinically significant Abnormalities on pre-treatment laboratory evaluation
* Medical condition that would (based on the opinion of the investigator) compromise patient's safety.
* Continued drug abuse
* Pre-menopausal women not using contraception
* Previous organ transplant
* Hypersensitivity to sulfur
sponsor: The Foundation for Orthopaedics and Regenerative Medicine
